────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
gradient  {monad, the_stone}
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  stationary imasm   eluent the_stone → monad   5 steps

  step  %B    hold   pull(A→B)   analyte
   void    —    0.00   1.33→0.00   monad  VOID — the column never gripped it
     —    —    2.00   0.00→1.33   the_stone  RETAINED — B never out-pulls the column

  0 of 2 eluted; 0 co-eluting pair(s); 1 retained; 1 in the void.
  a void peak separates from nothing — it needs a stationary phase that binds it.
  a retained analyte needs a STRONGER B, not a longer run — the walk never reaches its hold.
